snippet.title: Skopje83 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a city thrust into disarray by an unknown event and survive the hordes of mutated abominations that lurk at every corner. You’ll have to fight through enemies & bosses, scavenge loot and survive the hostile city.

Buy Skopje 83: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211980/Skopje_83/
